items.title: 4.3.4 Combining List and Stack to Perform Sequential Operations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining a list and a stack (PDF 121-122).

blocks.text: List data lachak se rakhti aur stack Last-In, First-Out tarteeb lagata hai, to mil kar woh kaam karte hain jin mein taaza tareen element pehle process karna ho. [10, 20, 30, 40, 50] ulatne ke liye: har element khali stack par push karein, phir ek ek pop kar ke wapas list mein dalein. Stack LIFO hai, is liye list [50, 40, 30, 20, 10] ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
numbers = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
stack = []
for n in numbers:
....stack.append(n)          # push
numbers = []
while stack:
....numbers.append(stack.pop())    # pop back into the list
print(numbers)    # [50, 40, 30, 20, 10]

blocks.prompt: Do aur kaam bataiye jin mein list aur stack mil kar kaam karte hain.
blocks.explanation: Undo (document ki halaton ki list aur taaza amal ka stack) aur backtracking (intikhabaat ki list aur ab tak aazmaye raste ka stack).

items: List aur stack: sab push, sab pop, aur tarteeb ulat: [50, 40, 30, 20, 10].
